coverage.historicalIdentity: Bridge requires original parsed directory MXID; no chain-address derivation, missing identity no Issue, resolver retarget denied before Issue, WhoAmI substitution rejected
coverage.profileIntent: Original Social idempotency store prepared/rejected/completed statuses; original request/account/device/key bound; ambiguous operation cannot be replaced by another key
coverage.crossStoreCancellation: Square effect occurs once, cancellation before Social avatar/settings completion retains original prepared intent; cold reopen and same-key/body retry settles without changing Square bytes
coverage.invalidRecovery: Invalid avatar and stale actor do not dispatch Square; known invalid Square profile body settles as rejected and corrected new intent works
coverage.privacyMerge: Privacy changes after Square effect are preserved; profile commits only avatar and original identity QR
coverage.context: Original request context is not persisted; no remote revalidation under store lock

limitations: Authority and local HS HTTP server in tests are explicitly software QA, not a real user/HS or public acceptance.
Actual MatrixAudienceAuthority is absent from current daemon wiring; Directory alone does not make the service usable.
Source bridge is not newly mounted; credential provenance/enrollment remains an existing protected producer requirement.
Generic action proofs, original action nonce effect commitment, other cross-store mutations and cross-device uncertain-intent recovery remain required.
First full race/build logs before the privacy merge are preserved separately and are not relabeled as final source validation.
